safetyInfo.title: How can we reach you if needed?
safetyInfo.subtitle: We use these details only if you're in danger. No one sees them except the on-call clinician in an emergency.
safetyInfo.shareLocation: Allow my location to be known in emergencies only
safetyInfo.shareLocationHint: You can turn this off at any time
safetyInfo.phoneInvalid: Enter a valid mobile number starting with 05 or the country code.
safetyInfo.trustedNameRequired: Add the name of the person you trust, or remove their number.
safetyInfo.trustedPhoneRequired: Add the mobile number of the person you trust, or remove their name.
safetyInfo.skipWhy: Why this helps: if you're in danger and we can't reach you, these details are what let our team get help to you. You can add them later in Settings.
